name: won-base
description: Portable, base-agnostic Won storefront IP layer — generic composable blocks + design tokens. Overlays onto pristine Horizon (client track A) or Skeleton (product track B).

rules.colorCascade: Global color_scheme is the source of truth. A per-block override is opt-in and only emits an inline style shadowing the scheme var when the setting is filled.
rules.richText: Headings use inline_richtext, body uses richtext. No plain text/textarea for visible copy.
rules.variants: Presets are grounded-only quick-starts (evidence from real WF/design). Orthogonal axes underneath are free but guardrailed: sane per-axis defaults, visible_if pruning, token-only values, responsive clamps.
rules.neverTouch: Never edit Horizon/Skeleton vendor files. Additive won-* files only — that is what keeps this layer portable to both bases.

appBlocks.note: Theme cannot install apps. Sections accept @app blocks and presets pre-wire the slots; when the Won app is installed the slot lights up in place. Premium value lives here, behind Shopify OAuth + Billing.
